description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our facility, ensuring a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience. We are looking for a dynamic individual who can drive positive outcomes, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and maintain compliance with all regulatory standards. If you are a proven leader ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial performance, operational efficiency, and staff development.
Strong commitment to quality patient care and resident satisfaction.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center as an MDS Coordinator. In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring accurate and timely submission in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the needs of our residents.

This position offers a unique opportunity to leverage your clinical assessment skills and regulatory knowledge to positively impact patient care and facility operations. We are looking for a professional who is committed to excellence and thrives in a collaborative environment.

Join a team where your contributions are valued, and you play a key role in maintaining high standards of care and compliance.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 1 year experience as an MDS Coordinator
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 assessment and care planning
Strong understanding of federal and state long-term care regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Family Medicine MD to join a network of specialty medical clinics across New York City. This role offers a unique opportunity to focus on workers' compensation and no-fault/lien cases, providing essential care to a specific patient demographic.

The ideal candidate will thrive in an environment that prioritizes patient recovery and efficient case management. This position is structured with a compensation model that is very heavy on bonuses, offering significant earning potential beyond the base salary. Weekend availability is a key requirement for this role.

Join a team committed to making a difference in the lives of patients navigating workers' compensation and personal injury claims. We are looking for a physician who is passionate about this specialized area of medicine and ready to contribute to a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree and valid New York medical license
Must be Workers' Compensation Board (WCB) certified
Proven experience with workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases
Ability to work weekends as required
Comfortable working in a practice that does not accept major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is approximately $180,000 per year, with a structure that is very heavy on bonuses and less on base salary.
